subject.title: fix(ui): neutralize Usage CSV text cells [AI]

question: Should Usage CSV exports intentionally prioritize spreadsheet-safe rendering by prefixing formula-leading text cells, despite changing those cells’ raw CSV values for non-spreadsheet consumers?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow and proven, but the acceptable compatibility contract for a user-visible export format is a product decision rather than a test-only repair.

options.title: Adopt spreadsheet-safe text exports
options.body: Approve apostrophe-prefix neutralization for formula-leading strings and treat the resulting raw-value change as the Usage CSV export contract.

options.title: Preserve raw-value fidelity
options.body: Keep the current serializer unchanged and pursue a different explicitly scoped export or user-selected safety policy if one is desired.

recommendation.title: Adopt spreadsheet-safe text exports
recommendation.body: Approve apostrophe-prefix neutralization for formula-leading strings and treat the resulting raw-value change as the Usage CSV export contract.
